messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to lock the Optimize toolkit MVP scope for Q3. Biggest customer asks: batching/caching recommendations, regression alerts from evals, prompt-set management, and per-route cache controls. Also a couple asks around canary rollouts for quantized variants. Thoughts?

kevin: +1. My take: prioritize API-first surface for recommendations and regression alerts. UI can follow. Main risk is infra work for batching and cache telemetry (~3w).

sasha: For evals, we need a baseline prompt set and a regression detection pipeline. Propose auto-alert when embedding-sim or accuracy on core prompts drops >3%, and hallucination rate (entity hallucination) >2%. Also need versioned prompt sets.

diego: From CS: customers will accept API-first if docs + quickstart exist. Nimbus specifically wants per-route TTLs and the ability to change TTL without deploy.

aisha: Design can deliver a minimal mock for the console, but only after API is stable. Deliverables I can commit to: API spec doc, example UI mock, quickstart flow copy. Prototype ready in ~1.5w.

maya: Draft launch criteria — please react with OK or concerns: 
- API: /recommend endpoints for batching/caching recs + config flags
- Evals: baseline prompt sets + regression alerts pipeline + alerting hooks
- Docs: quickstart + config examples
- Tests: e2e on Hosted + Dedicated, perf regression guardrails
- Security: completed review and threat model
Is Sept 15 realistic?

kevin: Sept 15 is optimistic. If we scope to API + eval backend only, Sept 30 is doable. Add UI and we're slipping to Oct. Need final signoff on infra SLOs and cost budget before we can commit.

maya: Ok — let's vote on scope/schedule: 
A) API + eval backend (Sept 30)
B) + minimal UI (Oct 28)
C) Full per-route controls + UI (Nov)
Please react.

sasha: A

diego: A

kevin: A (note: requires 2-day spike to validate batching kernels and perf plan)

aisha: B if we can ship very small UI for CS workflows, otherwise A

ops-bot: Reminder — Q3 OKR alignment review on 2025-09-05 16:00

maya: Consensus = Option A. Next action items: Kevin — post tech plan + task list by EOD Friday. Sasha — assemble baseline prompt sets and propose regression thresholds. Diego — collect top 3 TTL/per-route asks from customers. Aisha — draft quickstart copy for API.

kevin: Will do. High-level tech plan posted: https://redwood.example/s/optimize-q3-plan (link to outline).

kevin: Quick config example for the recommend API to include in docs:
```
POST /v1/optimize/recommend
{
  "model": "rwd-7b-quant",
  "route": "/chat/compose",
  "history_policy": "kv_prefix",
  "batching": {"max_tokens":1024,"latency_ms":50},
  "cache": {"enabled": true, "ttl_sec":3600}
}
```

maya: Perfect — that'll go in the quickstart. Kevin, include perf acceptance criteria (p50 < 75ms on short seqs, no >5% throughput regression) in the plan.

kevin: Added. I'll tag infra for SLOs and cost estimate.

maya: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after tech plan and prompt sets are in. :thumbsup:
